notes: Fixes Telegram post images never showing up in the panel (list or Details popup) even though the same image sends to the channel fine: the panel was building the image's web address assuming a 'public/storage' shortcut link exists on the server, but that link can only be created by a command line this host doesn't give access to, so every image address was silently broken - the image itself was always saved correctly, the panel just couldn't point a browser at it. Now served through a route the same way this panel already handles blog article images, so no such link is ever needed. No database changes.
